page_title: BHA 2-2 LEI | Brighton v Leicester 12/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Substitution. Kasey McAteer makes way for Jake Evans (Leicester).
90+5' A cross from a corner kick by Leicester is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
90+4' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Leicester) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Leicester win a corner kick.
90+3' Substitution. Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Leicester) in, Stephy Mavididi out.
90+2' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the right post is denied by a decent save from Mads Hermansen.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
89' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
87' OFF THE POST! Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the right post!
86' A dangerous looking corner kick from Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) is cleared to safety by the defence.
85' Kasey McAteer (Leicester) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
82' Simon Adingra goes off the pitch and Brajan Gruda (Brighton) comes on.
81' Leicester are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
79' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
76' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Leicester players have a reason to celebrate!
75' Wait! Referee Darren Bond has indicated he is going to review the Leicester goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

74' 2 - 2 The ball from the free kick finds its way to Caleb Okoli (Leicester) who finds himself some space and scores with a thunderous header into the bottom right corner. An incredible long-range header!
73' It looks like Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) saw red with that tackle. Darren Bond won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
71' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) gets a yellow card.
70' Here is a change. Yankuba Minteh is going off and Fabian Hurzeler gives the last tactical orders to Solly March (Brighton).
70' Substitution. Matt O'Riley makes his way off the pitch and Diego Gomez (Brighton) comes on as his replacement.
68' Booking. Oliver Skipp (Leicester) receives a caution from the referee.
68' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
68' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Bart Verbruggen intercepts the ball. The ball goes out for a corner. Leicester can continue in their attacking effort.
67' Patson Daka (Leicester) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
67' Boubakary Soumare (Leicester) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
63' Darren Bond shows a yellow card to Caleb Okoli (Leicester), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
61' That's the end of the game for Wilfred Ndidi, who is replaced by Oliver Skipp (Leicester).
61' Ruud van Nistelrooy has decided to substitute Luke Thomas and he is replaced by Ricardo Pereira (Leicester).
61' Here comes a substitution. Patson Daka (Leicester) is brought on as a substitute for Jamie Vardy.
60' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leicester.

59' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Leicester are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
57' Brighton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
55' 2 - 1 Goal! Joao Pedro (Brighton) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Mads Hermansen to commit before slotting the penalty into the top right corner.
55' Joao Pedro (Brighton) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
52' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
52' There's a break in play and referee Darren Bond must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Brighton using VAR. This could be interesting!
51' Darren Bond interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Luke Thomas (Leicester). The referee's verdict is crystal clear. A penalty is awarded to Brighton!

51' Simon Adingra (Brighton) found himself in a promising position. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made a decent save.
50' Matt O'Riley (Brighton) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Mads Hermansen anticipates well and smothers the ball.
49' Kasey McAteer (Leicester) trips an opposition player and Darren Bond signals a foul.
47' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) takes the free kick from the edge of the box but the defensive wall makes the block.

47' Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Brighton.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Leicester comes to nothing.

45+5' Kasey McAteer (Leicester) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the top of the net but Bart Verbruggen keeps it out. Leicester have been awarded a corner kick.
45+5' It seemed like Luke Thomas (Leicester) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
45+2' Matt O'Riley (Brighton) fires a shot from close range, but he is somehow only able to hit the right post!
45+1' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) is punished with the yellow card.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
43' Joao Pedro (Brighton) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was! The ball goes out of play and Leicester will have a goal kick.

43' Brighton slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
41' Joao Pedro (Brighton) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
38' 1 - 1 Goal! Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:1.
36' Luke Thomas (Leicester) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety. Now Leicester have a corner.
34' Leicester are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
31' The booking goes to Mads Hermansen (Leicester).
31' 1 - 0 Goal! Joao Pedro (Brighton) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Mads Hermansen to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
30' Joao Pedro (Brighton) is going to take the penalty!
29' Conor Coady (Leicester) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.

29' Play continues despite the shouts by some Brighton players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Darren Bond interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
28' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Conor Coady (Leicester). Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for Brighton.
27' Simon Adingra (Brighton) blows a good chance to score. He collects a pass inside the box, but his effort to the middle of the goal is brilliantly blocked. Great defending!

26' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) gets free in the box and latches onto a good cross, but somehow he sends the ball narrowly wide of the right post from the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leicester.
25' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) meets a cross inside the box, but Mads Hermansen wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.

23' Great solo effort from Stephy Mavididi (Leicester)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort rose just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
23' Leicester seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
21' Leicester have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

21' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Leicester.
18' Luke Thomas (Leicester) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
16' Simon Adingra (Brighton) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the left post is smartly dealt with by Mads Hermansen.
15' The Brighton players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
14' Kasey McAteer (Leicester) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

11' Simon Adingra (Brighton) starts an individual run, not looking to pass to a teammate, and easily weaves through the defence to get deep inside the box. He shoots low, but misses the goal by a whisker! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leicester.
11' Wonderful movement by Brighton. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

9' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Leicester will have a goal kick.
8' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
7' Mads Hermansen makes a brilliant save! Danny Welbeck (Brighton) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper low into the middle of the goal.
5' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
4' The resulting corner, taken by Yasin Ayari (Brighton), comes to nothing.

3' Simon Adingra (Brighton) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Brighton will take a corner kick.

2' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Brighton are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Leicester will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Darren Bond.
